chunks.title: Light Up The House
chunks.text: Project: Light Up The House (2026). Tagline: Third-person sci-fi repair adventure: fix three broken systems before the countdown hits zero.. Type: Team of 3 · Unreal Engine 5. Roles: Project Manager, Game Developer, UI Implementation. Key Contributions: Led development as game developer and project manager for a 3-person team, coordinating scope and delivery in UE5. Built the tool and appliance interaction loop: pickup (press I) and fix (press E) logic, tied to a BPI_Interaction Blueprint Interface so every interactable actor (tools, appliances) shares a common contract. The interface uses enum-driven logic and is reusable across actors. Implemented the UI/UX system across the Widget Blueprint stack: splash screen, main menu (hover animations, settings overlay with volume slider, quit logic), pause menu, and the proximity-based "Info Card" system that detects when the player nears a broken appliance and shows the correct tool using On Actor Begin/End Overlap. Handled win/loss state management through the Level Manager.. Description: Light Up The House is a third-person sci-fi exploration-adventure built in Unreal Engine 5. You play Mr. Robo, a robotic operative aboard a space shuttle that has lost total power. The objective: find the right tool for each of three broken systems, repair them before a countdown timer hits zero, and light the house back up.. Technologies: Unreal Engine 5 (Blueprints), Blender.

chunks.title: The Floor Is A Liar
chunks.text: Project: The Floor Is A Liar (2026). Tagline: A 3D browser game where the rules might be lying to you.. Type: Solo · Three.js browser game. Roles: Solo developer, Designer, QA. Key Contributions: Designed the rule mechanic, tile effects, level progression and scoring system. Built the Three.js scene in React Three Fiber, with a follow camera, lighting, an animated character and portal, and raycast-based hover and click-to-move. Fixed mobile usability by adjusting the camera for portrait view. Designed the Supabase/PostgreSQL schema with Row Level Security, validated save functions and a privacy-safe leaderboard. Wrote 69 automated tests across 12 suites, including real raycasting and level-solvability tests. Deployed with Git and Vercel CI/CD and documented the project.. Description: FloorIsALiar is a disco-themed 3D puzzle-arcade game. Players cross a floating dance floor of colored tiles to reach an exit portal. Each round, a loudspeaker announces a rule about one tile color, such as "Orange tiles are slippery!", and the rule can be true or a lie. Players must decide whether to trust it, and whether to take the short risky route or the long safe one. It ships with accounts, saved runs, a stats dashboard and a global leaderboard.. Technologies: React, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Tailwind, Supabase, Vitest, Vercel.

chunks.title: The Mask That Holds
chunks.text: Project: The Mask That Holds (2026). Tagline: Global Game Jam entry, built in 48 hours around the theme Mask.. Type: Global Game Jam · 48 hours · Team of 6. Roles: Project Manager, Level Designer, Narrative Designer, Environment Designer. Key Contributions: Led concept and scope as project manager. Shaped Tokyo 3030's decaying, mist-choked visual identity as environment designer. Translated it into playable space as level designer, where danger and safety read environmentally rather than through UI.. Description: Built in 48 hours for Global Game Jam around the theme Mask. Set in Tokyo, 3030, pollution has consumed the city, and a mysterious force has begun turning its people into formless mist. Only those wearing the ancient, mythical Auralian mask can hold onto their shape. You play the one person left who still remembers what it means to have a form, wearing the mask and fighting to survive against the thing that is unmaking everyone else.. Technologies: Unity 3D, Blender.

chunks.title: VR Escape Room
chunks.text: Project: VR Escape Room (2026). Tagline: Collect 4 keys against the clock to escape the mansion, in VR.. Type: Team of 4 · Unity 3D (VR). Roles: Interaction Designer, Gameplay Programmer. Key Contributions: Investigated and implemented VR teleportation and pickup interactions, testing multiple interaction models for usability. Built visual feedback cues (glow and float effects) to test how affordance guides player behavior. Iteratively tuned puzzle pacing through playtesting, adjusting key placement and unlock logic based on real player feedback. Added random spawn points for keys to maintain replayability.. Description: A VR escape room built to explore how physical interaction models and visual feedback affect player behavior in 3D space. Goal: the player needs to collect 4 keys under a time constraint in order to escape the mansion, but on each collection gets teleported to a new area. The screen starts flashing red when the player starts to run out of time, adding difficulty and visual distress.. Technologies: Unity 3D, VR, XR interaction.

chunks.title: Harry Potter Flight and Crash VR Simulation
chunks.text: Project: Harry Potter Flight and Crash VR Simulation (2026). Tagline: A solo VR flight-and-crash simulation built in under 27 hours.. Type: Solo · Unity 3D (VR) · Final lab exam. Roles: VR Developer (solo). Key Contributions: Built vehicle and flight controls in VR. Implemented flight physics (lift, momentum, steering and crash behavior). Built collision detection and crash-response handling. Added teleportation on pressing a red button. Owned the full development cycle solo: scripting, testing and debugging.. Description: An independently built VR flight-and-crash simulation with a Harry Potter-themed setting, built end-to-end in Unity3D: vehicle controls, flight physics and collision handling, all implemented solo under 27 hours for a final lab exam.. Technologies: Unity 3D, Virtual Reality, XR interaction.

chunks.title: Oakridge Hollow
chunks.text: Project: Oakridge Hollow (2026). Tagline: A Minecraft-inspired 3D voxel sandbox that runs 100% in the browser.. Type: Solo · Web 3D Programming course project. Roles: 3D Web Developer, Interactive UI/Audio Designer. Key Contributions: Designed and built the 3D voxel engine, procedural texture and audio generators, dual camera controls, NPC behavior and a responsive HUD from scratch. Procedural World & Foraging: generated seeded rolling terrain, a pond, a lantern-lit cottage, and oak trees that drop collectible, edible apples when harvested. Mining, Building & Inventory Loop: built raycast block breaking and placing with particle bursts, spinning 3D pickups, and an 8-slot live resource hotbar. Roaming Villagers & Animals: modeled and animated villagers (with speech bubbles) and farm animals (sheep, pigs, chickens) that navigate terrain and avoid water. Dual Camera & Trackpad-Friendly UX: added a quick Break/Place mode switcher (Q), Orbit View, First-Person Walk/Fly mode (WASD), and a Settings modal. Automated Day / Dusk / Night Cycle: built smooth lighting, sky and shadow transitions that cycle automatically every 90 seconds or manually via Settings. Rendering: stores voxels in a spatial Map ("x,y,z" to blockType) with neighbor-based face culling, and draws deterministic 16x16 pixel-art canvas bitmaps mapped with THREE.NearestFilter. Procedural Audio (Web Audio API): synthesizes block crunches, footsteps, animal and villager calls, and ambient chimes in real time using noise buffers, bandpass filters and oscillators.. Description: Oakridge Hollow is a browser-based, Minecraft-inspired 3D voxel sandbox built with Three.js and the Web Audio API for a Web 3D Programming course. It runs 100% client-side with zero external assets. All pixel-art textures, terrain, animated villagers and animals, day-dusk-night lighting and sound effects are generated procedurally in code.. Technologies: Three.js, Web Audio API, JavaScript.

chunks.title: Shadows of the Slums
chunks.text: Project: Shadows of the Slums (2025). Tagline: A maze-escape thriller: witness a gang murder, then survive.. Type: Team of 3 · Unity 3D. Roles: Level Designer, Narrative Designer, Gameplay Programmer. Key Contributions: Owned one full scene independently, building it end to end. Environment: designed the maze sequence and pacing for that section of the escape. Systems: programmed core gameplay in C#, including character movement, animation state control and scene-switching logic. Narrative: designed and validated the trust-based NPC dialogue system central to the story. Since the worker's survival depends on which NPCs choose to help him, I mapped out how trust would be earned or lost.. Description: Shadows of the Slums is a maze-escape thriller built in Unity3D by a 3-person team. The story follows a regular worker who witnesses a gang murder and gets seen by the killer. Now marked, he has to survive, evade the mafia, and find a way to expose them, relying on NPCs he can (or cannot) trust to help him along the way. Each of the three of us owned one full scene end to end: environment, NPC dialogue and animation.. Technologies: Unity 3D, C#.

chunks.title: AR Piano
chunks.text: Project: AR Piano (2026). Tagline: An air piano: play notes by pressing keys in mid-air, tracked by webcam.. Type: Solo · Computer vision. Roles: Computer Vision Developer. Key Contributions: Built the full pipeline solo: hand and finger landmark tracking using MediaPipe, and real-time video processing with OpenCV. Wrote the logic that maps tracked finger positions to on-screen key zones and triggers the corresponding note. Solved the gesture-to-input problem: detecting a "press" reliably (a finger crossing a key's threshold) without false triggers from natural hand movement.. Description: An AR air piano built in Python using OpenCV and MediaPipe. A webcam tracks your hand in real time, maps finger positions to piano keys rendered on screen, and plays notes when you "press" a key in mid-air, with no physical keyboard involved.. Technologies: Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe.

chunks.title: Six of Crows Trailer
chunks.text: Project: Six of Crows Trailer (2026). Tagline: A TV-series opening sequence for Six of Crows, made with motion graphics.. Type: Solo · Post-Production course at CEGA. Roles: Motion Graphics Artist. Key Contributions: Parallax compositing: layered sky, tree silhouette and birds at different depths with a simulated camera push for scene depth. Luma matte transition: dissolved black into the title card using a smoke/ink matte. Kinetic typography: animated the title build ("SI" to "SIX OF CROWS") with After Effects text range selectors. Null-parented rig: built a reusable card fan using a fixed rotational offset per layer, parented to a null. 3D layer animation: flipped each character card into frame using 3D rotation. Blend mode compositing: layered a smoke texture in Screen mode behind the cards for depth without hard edges. Shape wipe transition: used a bird silhouette as a wipe between the title and card sequence.. Description: For my final project in the post-production course at the Centre of Excellence for Gaming and Animation (CEGA), I adapted my favourite book, Six of Crows, into a TV-series opening sequence using motion graphics.. Technologies: Adobe After Effects.

Description: An interactive 3D solar system built in Three.js. A glowing sun sits at the center with planets travelling around it along visible orbit rings. OrbitControls let the viewer drag to rotate the view and scroll to zoom.. Technologies: Three.js, OrbitControls.

chunks.title: Portal Scene
chunks.text: Project: Portal Scene (2026). Tagline: An atmospheric Three.js scene: open the chest, then travel through the portal.. Type: Three.js interactive scene. Roles: Developer. Key Contributions: Built a glowing portal inside an ivy-covered arch, lit by torches, with a clickable treasure chest. Scripted a camera move that zooms onto the open chest and then travels inside the portal, where the viewer can rotate, pan and explore.. Description: An atmospheric interactive 3D scene built in Three.js. A glowing portal sits inside an ivy-covered arch, lit by torches, with a treasure chest in front. A prompt invites the viewer to click the chest to open it. The camera then zooms onto the open chest and travels inside the portal, giving the user the freedom to rotate, pan and explore the other scene.. Technologies: Three.js.

## Professional Summary
Computer Science undergraduate at NED University of Engineering and Technology, specializing in Gaming & Animation (CGPA 3.657). I build gameplay systems, UI and interactions in Unreal Engine 5, Unity3D and Three.js, including VR projects and browser games, working both solo and in teams. Beyond development, I have worked through the production pipeline, including story development, storyboarding, animatics and motion graphics in After Effects, so I understand pacing and feel, not just code. I bring strong C#/OOP programming and a fast learning style to a team building engaging games.

## About Me
I'm Zarina, a Computer Science undergrad at NED University, specializing in Gaming & Animation. I build gameplay systems, UI and interactions in Unreal Engine 5 and Unity3D, with a chunk of that work in VR and full gameplay loops built both solo and in teams. Outside pure development, I've worked through the production pipeline too: story and storyboarding for an original short, and motion graphics in After Effects. That range means I understand pacing and feel, not just code.

Beyond code, I am active in campus life. I have been part of the GameVerse society's events and logistics team and hosted its flagship event, GameCon, at both editions. chunks.title: FAQ and Q&A
chunks.text:
# Frequently Asked Questions

### What kind of roles is Zarina looking for?
Zarina is open to game development, game programming and interactive 3D roles and internships. Zarina is currently a Game Developer Intern at Aerox ERP, working on web and 3D interactions, with graduation from NED University expected in 2027.

### Which engines and tools does Zarina use?
Unreal Engine 5 (Blueprints, Widget Blueprints, Blueprint Interfaces), Unity with C# including VR/XR, and Three.js / React Three Fiber for browser games. Zarina also uses Blender, Adobe After Effects, Python with OpenCV and MediaPipe, Supabase, Vitest, Vercel and Git.

### Which projects can I play right now?
The Floor Is A Liar (https://floor-is-a-liar.vercel.app/) and Oakridge Hollow (https://minecraft-six-psi.vercel.app/) both run in the browser.

### Has Zarina done game jams?
Yes. The Mask That Holds was built in 48 hours for Global Game Jam 2026 around the theme Mask, with Zarina as project manager and level, narrative and environment designer.

### Can I download Zarina's resume?
Yes. Walk into the Study Nook and press E on the resume on the desk, or use the Download Resume button in the pause menu. It is also linked from the classic 2D view.

### How do I contact Zarina?
Email zarinaiqbal04@gmail.com, connect on LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/zarina-iqbal-97161528a), or drop a letter in the mailbox on the Dev Realm island.

### How was this 3D portfolio created?
It is built with vanilla Three.js and TypeScript, with responsive HTML/CSS overlays. No heavy frameworks are used, which keeps the bundle light and the frame rate smooth on phones.

### Who is Mochi?
Mochi is the companion red panda who lives in the studio. Mochi knows Zarina's background, games and skills and answers visitor questions in the chat.
